title: Toy Chest

sources.title: Toy Chest
markers: A tiny chest that can be found in the [[Grymforge]]. Interacting with it reveals another chest.

summary: Interact to reveal a trapped Harper chest in Grymforge.

fields.Use: Interact with the tiny chest to reveal another chest. Light can disarm the revealed trap. The nearby Undelivered Letter describes the trick.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
